# Table 1. Pathway levers and the theoretical-limit assumptions (generated by tools/pathways_methods.py from outputs/data/pathways/levers.json and outputs/data/pathways/theoretical_limit.json; do not edit by hand)

The Reference projection; each lever follows a normalised logistic adoption path from 2026 (observed, unchanged) to full strength in 2035 (full roll-out by 2035 following RECC (Pauliuk et al. 2024, J. Ind. Ecol. 28, 1699: circular-economy strategies fully implemented by 2035); sensitivities: full roll-out by 2030 and by 2045). One rule for every adoption window 2026 → E (W = E − 2026): midpoint 2026 + W/2, speed k = ln(81) / (2W/3), 10-90% of adoption within the middle two-thirds of the window; w(2026) = 0, w(E) = 1, w = 1 after E (by 2035: midpoint 2030.5, k = 0.7324; by 2030: 2028, 1.6479; by 2045: 2035.5, 0.3469). Levers L1-L5; the typology shares stay at the Reference held mix in every run. Tags: DATA (measured), LITERATURE (cited), DECISION (author).

**Removed lever.** The denser typology mix (lever of pathways_v2, removed in pathways_v3.1) was not carried forward: within the embodied-carbon scope a denser mix raises A1-A3 per m2 (attached typologies carry more per m2), while its benefits (infrastructure, operational energy, land) are outside the scope. Values from git tag pathways_v2 (Reference): attached share 39.40% -> 41.39% / 55.40% (Moderate / Ambitious); carbon -0.39% / -2.94% vs the Reference; floor area 89.57 -> 88.85 / 84.16 Mm²; carbon per m² 240.9 -> 241.9 / 248.8 kg CO₂e; lever Shapley share of Reference − P5 1.7% / 5.8%.

## Theoretical limit TL

> TL is a hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway: all assumptions at full strength from 1 January 2027, combining best observed attributes of different buildings and places; not a proposal or a feasible pathway (potentials hierarchy: theoretical > technical > realisable).

TL = P5 Combined (Moderate) with the seven overrides below (TL1-TL7), all at full strength from 1 January 2027 (no adoption path); 2026 observed and untouched. This is identical to P5 Ambitious with TL1-TL6 (TL1-TL6 replace L1, L2 / L3 and L5; TL7 is the Ambitious L4), asserted to 1e-12 in every run. The adopted decarbonisation applies in TL as in every run (A1-A3 item paths of Horup et al. 2025, A4-A5 e^(-0.01 (t - 2025)); the lift held at 2025 as in the Reference). Sensitivity: TL, gradual adoption (SI), the same TL on the adoption path of the levers, full roll-out by 2035 (adopted).
